title: Vanguard 衛星計畫
summary: 建立分日照與地影的能量帳，求電池容量及充電餘裕。
summaryEn: Build a sunlight/eclipsed energy ledger and determine battery capacity and charging margin.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

Return to the investigation: Map solar cells, regulator, battery and transmitter; label power direction and efficiency on each interface.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Each efficiency appears once; Wh and W use separate columns.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。額定容量需 0.375 Wh，與地影時間成正比。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Required rating becomes 0.375 Wh, proportional to eclipse time.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 所有效率只計一次，Wh 與 W 分欄。
steps.checkEn: Each efficiency appears once; Wh and W use separate columns.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Vanguard 1 是早期利用太陽能電池的衛星，適合研究供電與量測壽命的耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Vanguard 1 was an early solar-powered satellite, motivating study of power and measurement lifetime.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立分日照與地影的能量帳，求電池容量及充電餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Build a sunlight/eclipsed energy ledger and determine battery capacity and charging margin.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 每軌能量守恆需把負載、充電效率及放電效率分開；額定電量不等於允許放出的電量。
knowledge.textEn: Per-orbit conservation separates load, charge efficiency and discharge efficiency; rated energy is not fully usable energy.

quiz.question: 「電力介面表」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Power-interface ledger: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: E額定≥Pt/(ηDOD)=0.2×0.5/(0.8×0.5)=0.25 Wh；忽略老化與低溫，尚非飛行選型。
交付日照地影能量帳、效率假設、容量與一項老化待測項。
若日照端電壓正常但下一地影提早掉電，比較充入安時與可用容量，不能只查太陽翼電壓。
optionsEn: Rated E≥Pt/(ηDOD)=0.2×0.5/(0.8×0.5)=0.25 Wh; aging and temperature remain excluded, so this is not flight sizing.
Deliver the orbit energy ledger, efficiency assumptions, capacity and an aging measurement still needed.
Normal sunlight voltage with early eclipse dropout requires checking charge throughput and usable capacity, not voltage alone.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若日照端電壓正常但下一地影提早掉電，比較充入安時與可用容量，不能只查太陽翼電壓。 與本階段判準一起判讀：所有效率只計一次，Wh 與 W 分欄。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Normal sunlight voltage with early eclipse dropout requires checking charge throughput and usable capacity, not voltage alone. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Each efficiency appears once; Wh and W use separate columns.

steps.title: 電力介面表 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Power-interface ledger · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「電力介面表」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Power-interface ledger and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若日照端電壓正常但下一地影提早掉電，比較充入安時與可用容量，不能只查太陽翼電壓。
對照「電力介面表」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。若每軌充入可用能量不足，先減少負載或提高發電量；增大電池僅延後能量赤字失效。
本階段必須重驗：所有效率只計一次，Wh 與 W 分欄。
steps.instructionEn:
Normal sunlight voltage with early eclipse dropout requires checking charge throughput and usable capacity, not voltage alone.
Against the nominal Power-interface ledger result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. If usable charge per orbit is insufficient, reduce load or increase generation; a larger battery only delays an energy-deficit failure.
Reverify this criterion: Each efficiency appears once; Wh and W use separate columns.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若日照端電壓正常但下一地影提早掉電，比較充入安時與可用容量，不能只查太陽翼電壓。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Normal sunlight voltage with early eclipse dropout requires checking charge throughput and usable capacity, not voltage alone.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 所有效率只計一次，Wh 與 W 分欄。
steps.checkEn: Each efficiency appears once; Wh and W use separate columns.

quiz.questionEn: Power-interface ledger: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 每軌能量守恆需把負載、充電效率及放電效率分開；額定電量不等於允許放出的電量。

If usable charge per orbit is insufficient, reduce load or increase generation; a larger battery only delays an energy-deficit failure. steps.title: 電力介面表 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Power-interface ledger · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「電力介面表」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Power-interface ledger and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付日照地影能量帳、效率假設、容量與一項老化待測項。
在交接件中加入「電力介面表」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：所有效率只計一次，Wh 與 W 分欄。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立分日照與地影的能量帳，求電池容量及充電餘裕。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the orbit energy ledger, efficiency assumptions, capacity and an aging measurement still needed.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Power-interface ledger: Each efficiency appears once; Wh and W use separate columns.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build a sunlight/eclipsed energy ledger and determine battery capacity and charging margin. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。所有效率只計一次，Wh 與 W 分欄。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Each efficiency appears once; Wh and W use separate columns.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 所有效率只計一次，Wh 與 W 分欄。
steps.checkEn: Each efficiency appears once; Wh and W use separate columns.
